headline: Callstack wired something in between: Jev picks the next UI action, and their open-source agent-device presses the button.
text:
Most automated tests either follow a rigid script or burn a full chat model on every tap. Callstack wired something in between: Jev picks the next UI action, and their open-source agent-device presses the button.

How it works: agent-device reads the app’s accessibility tree…
